intrabar: High/low ordering within a bar is unknown. Time-to-high is hit-bar end upper bound, not exact touch time.
pathClassCaveat: CHOP is considered before IMMEDIATE inside the no-prior-negative-low branch; broad text precedence is ambiguous. Counts retained as descriptive only, never a training feature or gate.

sharedTargetLimitation: WAIT label uses future maximum utility among executable opens; optimistic oracle teacher can dominate BUY and promote systematic waiting/expiry. No test/data-dependent retune performed.
